CheckTitle: Ensure EPM Audit Data is Exported and Centrally Stored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: EPM Cloud access (EPM Automate, Service Administrator)
OCI tenancy access (IAM policies, Fusion environment settings, Logging, Monitoring)
Description: EPM audit data (sign-ins, administrative actions, configuration changes) should be exported regularly and stored centrally, for example in Object Storage.
Risk: Audit data kept only in EPM is limited by its retention and can be lost.
AuditProcedure: Confirm scheduled EPM audit exports are active, contain the expected fields and land in external storage.

Steps: Automate export (for example EPM Automate access log downloads), store it externally and test the pipeline.
